reviews.quote: Called Hayden to provide a quote on re roofing our house he returned our enquiry quickly and the quote was clearly detailed and explained. Given a start date and can say the communication was great the end result was amazing. Before and after photos show the difference. Thank you

reviews.quote: I was unable to get a roof replacement for 6 months in Hamilton. I saw Vic West add on Facebook so I gave them a call. Hayden promptly gave me quote and came straight away to measure up. Before I knew it 2 teams of trades were here and off with the old roof new battens and sisal new sheets on capped and flashed all in one day. Vic West are a professional team and I highly recommend.

He and his team were wonderful making quick work of getting the old roof off and new one on and cleaning up as well and it looks unbelievable like a new house! I couldn’t recommend Vicwest Roofing enough!!!
reviews.author: Rebecca Schultz

reviews.quote: These guys did a top job for me, going from tile to tin in Wendouree. Would recommend them 100%. Done in two days. Great effort. Thanks again. Cheers Don
reviews.author: Donald Stewart

reviews.quote: Hayden and his team replaced a rusting old iron roof on my old Creswick cottage with Colorbond ( Pale Eucalypt). Parts of the house were over 100 years old and it wasn’t an easy job. There were solar panels to be removed and replaced as well. The team did a great job, arriving very early each day and working solidly until knock off time. They ran a very tidy worksite and obviously took pride in workmanship, which was good to see. All the debris was removed at the end.
reviews.author: Helen Hanson

faqs_seed.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
faqs_seed.a: Real customer reviews mention one-day and two-day completions, but timing depends on roof size, access, safety setup, weather, asbestos status, solar panels, and material availability.

faqs_seed.q: Do you replace tile roofs with Colorbond?
faqs_seed.a: Yes. Case studies include tile-to-Colorbond replacements in Alfredton, Bendigo, and Williamstown, plus a customer review for a tile-to-tin job in Wendouree.

faqs_seed.q: Do you handle asbestos roof replacement?
faqs_seed.a: The Highton case study states asbestos cement sheeting was removed with licensed removal, containment, transport, disposal, and independent clearance certification.

faqs_seed.q: Can builders send plans for estimating?
faqs_seed.a: Yes. The Instagram mention asks builders to forward plans to estimating@vicwestroofing.com.au, and the new roofs page says estimators use CAD software.
The homepage and roof replacement page repeatedly state a 10-year workmanship warranty for roof replacements.

faqs_seed.q: Do you service Geelong and Melbourne's west?
faqs_seed.a: Yes. The website names Geelong, the Bellarine Peninsula, Surf Coast, Highton, Williamstown, Yarraville, Seddon, Altona, and Melbourne’s western suburbs.

narrative_drafts.about_us_draft: Vicwest Roofing is a Ballarat-based metal roofing company servicing homeowners, builders, and commercial clients across Western Victoria. Trading as VICWEST ROOFING under VICWEST GROUP PTY LTD, the business operates from Shed 3/31 Icon Dr, Delacombe and works across Ballarat, Geelong, Bendigo, Bacchus Marsh, Daylesford, Castlemaine, Creswick, Maryborough, and surrounding towns. The company’s work is built around roof replacements, new Colorbond and metal roofs, guttering, fascia, downpipes, architectural claddings, unit developments, and larger commercial roofing projects. The public website describes Vicwest as one of Western Victoria’s largest and most dedicated roofing companies, with over 20 years’ roofing experience and a commitment to high-10-year workmanship warranty in writing, responsiveness, and long-term client relationships. For homeowners, that means a practical process from first call through to quote, measure, old roof removal, new roof installation, cleanup, and warranty handover. For builders, it means CAD-trained estimating, scheduling that stays close to build progress, pre and post inspections, and the ability to send plans directly for estimating. Customers often mention Hayden by name. They describe clear quotes, prompt measuring, being on time for appointments, early starts, tidy worksites, and crews who work solidly until the job is complete. One Hamilton customer said two teams arrived and completed the old roof removal, battens, sisal, sheets, caps, and flashings in one day. A Wendouree customer described a tile-to-tin conversion finished in two days. A Creswick customer praised the team for replacing a rusting old iron roof on a cottage partly over 100 years old, managing solar panels, removing debris, and preserving the home’s character. Vicwest’s aim is straightforward: deliver metal roofing work that is well planned, well communicated, and built to withstand Victorian weather.
narrative_drafts.trust_signals_catalog: Trust signals should be made explicit and repeated in high-conversion areas. Location proof: Google Business Profile address at Shed 3/31 Icon Dr, Delacombe VIC 3356, plus contact-page address at 3/31 Icon Drive, Delacombe/Ballarat. Experience proof: the owned website claims “over 20 years’ experience,” while Localsearch states “Trading for 9 years,” so use the wording “20+ years’ roofing experience” and separately “ABN active since 2017” unless the client confirms founding history. Warranty proof: homepage and roof replacement pages state roof replacements are backed by a 10-year workmanship warranty, and the New Roofs page says all work is backed by a comprehensive warranty. Review proof: GBP rating 4.1 from 18 reviews, with strong five-star quotes from Wayne, Roland, Rebecca, Donald, Brad, and Helen. Project proof: named project pages in Alfredton, Creswick, Wendouree, Highton, Bendigo, and Williamstown, plus large image galleries for Scarsdale, Gordon, Lucas, Display Homes, and Ingenia Homes. Missing trust proof: VBA licence, insurance certificate, and verified team headcount.
